question: Which of the following organisations is credited with writing literary pieces for the abolition of Sati Pratha?
solution:
The correct answer is __**The Brahmo Samaj.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Brahmo Samaj **is credited with** writing literary pieces **for the** abolition of Sati Pratha.**
 
• **Sati Pratha** was a practice where a **widow** was expected to** immolate herself **on her **husband's funeral pyre**.
 
• The Brahmo Samaj was a **socio-religious reform movement** founded by **Raja Ram Mohan Roy in 1828.**
 
• The Brahmo Samaj believed in** monotheism** and **rejected idol worship, caste system,** and other social evils prevalent at that time.
 
• The Brahmo Samaj played a significant role in the** Indian Renaissance** and the social reform movements of the **19th and early 20th centuries**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Harijan Sevak Sangh **was founded by **Mahatma Gandhi in 1932** to work for the **upliftment of the Dalits.**
 
• The **Satya Shodhak Samaj** was founded by **Jyotirao Phule in 1873** to fight against the **caste system** and **promote education** for all.
 
• The **Bahujan Samaj Party **is a political party in India founded by** Kanshi Ram in 1984** to represent the interests of the **Bahujan Samaj (majority of the population).**
